description: Xcode from a .xip you downloaded (next: Recipes/xcode-platforms for simulator runtimes)

xcode.description: an Xcode .xip from https://developer.apple.com/download/all/ (any Apple ID; Apple does not offer it without one)

steps.name: Expand the .xip into /Applications (xip replaces the folder it expands into, so the step changes into it again after)
steps.run: work=/private/var/tmp/agent-vm-xcode; rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work" && cd "$work" && /usr/bin/xip --expand "$AGENT_VM_INPUT_XCODE" && cd "$work" && apps=$(ls -d *.app) && [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$apps" | wc -l)" -eq 1 ] && rm -rf "/Applications/$apps" && mv "$apps" /Applications/ && cd / && rm -rf "$work" && echo "/Applications/$apps" > /private/var/tmp/agent-vm-xcode-path

steps.name: Check that it is Apple's Xcode
steps.run: app=$(cat /private/var/tmp/agent-vm-xcode-path) && /usr/bin/codesign --verify --strict -R='anchor apple and identifier "com.apple.dt.Xcode"' "$app" && echo "$app: signed by Apple"

steps.name: Select it, accept its license, and install its first-launch packages
Let the box user debug without an administrator prompt
